description: Burn synth from the wallet to reduce debt: repay(tokens). "all" repays the whole debt. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data (to, data, value, gas) for the user's own wallet; simulated against the latest block first and refused if it would revert. Never signs or sends.

market.description: Market address (0x...) or symbol, e.g. NO-NVDA

owner.description: The user's wallet address (0x...). Used to read the position and as the simulated sender; nothing is signed.

tokens.description: Synth to repay as a decimal string, or "all"

name: prepare_repay
title: Prepare repay
